overview.title: Index: G to I (GPUs to intelligence)
overview.main_topic: Index entries from the 'GPUs' sub-entries to 'intelligence, purpose of'
overview.central_idea: This page finishes G with gradient-based optimization, gradient descent, GradientTape and GRU, covers H (heatmaps, hyperparameters, hybrid models), and covers much of I (image classification, image generation, image segmentation, IMDb, inference).
overview.importance: It points to the optimization basics (gradient descent and SGD) and to the three big computer-vision task families.
learning_objectives: Find where gradient-based optimization and SGD are explained
Find the image classification, segmentation and generation chapters

summary:
Index page printed 613 (PDF 637). Locators are **printed** pages: **add 24** for the PDF page.

**G (end).** *GPUs*: multi-GPU training 548–550 (PDF 572–574). *gradient ascent* in input space 291 (PDF 315), with JAX, PyTorch and TensorFlow versions at 294–295. **gradient-based optimization** 39–50 (PDF 63–74), with sub-entries backpropagation algorithm 46–50, derivatives 41–43 and stochastic gradient descent 43–46 (PDF 67–70). *gradient descent* 40, 291, 571, 596 (PDF 64), with tuning key parameters 154. *GradientTape* 294, 302 (scope 216). *ground-truth or annotations* 105. *GRU* 375, 424–439 (PDF 399) and GRU layers 434–604.

**H.** *heatmaps* 285, class activation 299–306. *Hebbian learning* 463. *History object* 112 (PDF 136). *hybrid models* 606 (PDF 630). *hybrid systems* 590. *Hyperband tuner* 542. *HyperModel class* 541. *hyperparameters* 149 (PDF 173), optimization 539–546 (PDF 563–570). *hypothesis space* 269, 441.

**I.** *image classification* 231, 309 (PDF 255), with ConvNets 232–241, data augmentation 252, pretrained models 256–266 (PDF 280–290) and training from scratch 241. *image generation* 508 (PDF 532), with deep learning for 509–518, diffusion models 518–530 and text-to-image models 531–537 (PDF 555–561). *image segmentation* 308, 309 (PDF 332), with training from scratch 311–318 and using a pretrained segmentation model 318–328 (PDF 342–352). *IMDb* 106, 396–398. *information leaks* 149. *inference*, faster with quantization 561. *instruction fine-tuning* 488–490 (PDF 512–514). *instance segmentation* 310. *int8* 188.

concepts.name: gradient-based optimization / gradient descent (index entries)
concepts.definition: gradient-based optimization is at printed 39–50 (PDF 63–74), with SGD at 43–46 (PDF 67–70). gradient descent is at 40, 291, 571, 596.
concepts.intuition: Chapter 2's 'engine of neural networks' runs from PDF 63 to 74.
concepts.technical: The later locators reuse gradient descent for gradient ascent in input space (291) and in the reflections on AI (571, 596).
concepts.significance: This is how every model in the book is trained.
concepts.example: Open PDF 67 for stochastic gradient descent.
concepts.misconception: Gradient descent finds a local minimum, not necessarily the global one.

concepts.name: image segmentation (index entry)
concepts.definition: Indexed at printed 308, 309 (PDF 332–333). Sub-entries: computer vision tasks 308–311, training from scratch 311–318, using a pretrained segmentation model 318–328.
concepts.intuition: The book trains a model from scratch first, then switches to prompting a pretrained one with target points (323–327).
concepts.technical: Related entries: instance segmentation 310, panoptic segmentation 310, IoU 316, 343.
concepts.significance: It is one of the three main computer-vision task families.
concepts.example: Open PDF 342 for the pretrained model.
concepts.misconception: Segmentation predicts a class for each pixel, not one label for the whole image.

concepts.name: hyperparameter optimization (index entry)
concepts.definition: hyperparameters are at printed 149 (PDF 173); optimization is at 539–546 (PDF 563–570), using KerasTuner, the Hyperband tuner and HyperModel.
concepts.intuition: PDF 173 explains why tuning on the validation set leaks information. PDF 563 automates the search.
concepts.technical: Related entries: BayesianOptimization tuner 542, RandomSearch tuner 542.
concepts.significance: It is part of the book's best practices for real-world models.
concepts.misconception: Tuning hyperparameters against the test set invalidates the test set.
